* Conduct regular field visits to borrower groups to facilitate timely repayments.
* Monitor repayment schedules and follow up with customers regarding upcoming and overdue instalments.
* Identify repayment delays and coordinate with the reporting manager to resolve collection-related issues.
* Maintain accurate records of collections, pending instalments, and overdue accounts.
* Ensure collection targets are achieved within the assigned timelines.

**B. Business Development**

* Address customer queries and coordinate with the appropriate team for resolution.
* Encourage responsible repayment practices and maintain regular customer engagement.
* Handle collection-related discussions professionally, respectfully, and in accordance with the bank's policies.

**D. Loan Portfolio Monitoring**

* Identify overdue accounts and follow up promptly to minimise collection delays.
* Maintain updated records of customer payments, outstanding balances, and follow-up activities.
* Report collection performance, overdue accounts, and repayment concerns to the reporting manager.
* Support the branch in maintaining a healthy loan portfolio.

**E. Reporting and Compliance**

* Submit daily collection reports and periodic business performance updates.
* Maintain accurate customer records and collection documentation.
* Follow the bank's policies, applicable regulatory requirements, and approved recovery procedures.
* Ensure transparent handling and timely reporting of all collections.
* Maintain customer confidentiality and professional conduct during field activities.

**3. Qualifications and Experience**

* Graduation preferred, subject to the employer's eligibility criteria.
* Experience in banking, microfinance, group loan collection, or financial services is an advantage.
* Knowledge of loan repayment procedures and field collection activities is preferred.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage customer relationships and achieve collection targets.
* Willingness to travel within the assigned territory for field visits.
* Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with branch teams.

**4. Key Skills Required**

* Group Loan Collection
* Field Collection and Customer Follow-up
* Business Development and Customer Acquisition
* Customer Relationship Management
* Loan Portfolio Monitoring
* Target Achievement
* Reporting and Documentation
* Communication and Negotiation Skills

**5. Performance Expectations**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Achievement of assigned loan collection targets.
* Timely collection of group loan instalments.
* Follow-up and management of overdue accounts.
* New customer acquisition and business generation.
* Maintenance of customer relationships.
* Accuracy of collection records and compliance with bank policies.

**6. Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should be field-oriented, customer-focused, and result-driven, with the ability to manage group loan collections while contributing to business development. Candidates who can balance effective repayment follow-up with professional customer relationship management will be preferred.

title: Technical Product & Solutions manager
description:
**Overview:** Samudra is looking for a **technically strong, hands-on professional** who can take complete ownership of our wastewater treatment product portfolio — from understanding the technology and customer requirement through system design, integration, costing, installation, commissioning, performance validation and after-sales technical support.

The person will be the **technical custodian of Samudra's Bio-Digester and Bio-STP solutions**, particularly:

· **DRDO Anaerobic Bio-Digester Technology | CSIR-NIIST NOWA technology**

· Integrated treatment systems combining anaerobic, biological and polishing

technologies

· Packaged / skid-mounted STPs

· Greywater and combined greywater-blackwater treatment

· Development of systems aimed at compliance with applicable CPCB/KSPCB/BIS standards, including **IS 18797:2024**, wherever applicable.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Technology Ownership:** The candidate shall develop an in-depth working knowledge of:

· DRDO Bio-Digester technology and its operating principles

· Anaerobic digestion processes

· DRDO inoculum / bacterial consortium requirements

· Hydraulic Retention Time and Organic Loading Rate

· BOD, COD, TSS and nutrient reduction

· CSIR-NIIST NOWA technology

· Greywater treatment processes

· Biological and physico-chemical treatment systems

· Aerobic and anaerobic treatment technologies

· Filtration and tertiary treatment systems

· Disinfection systems

· Sludge management

**Convert ToT Technology into Commercial Products:** A major responsibility will be to convert the technologies transferred to Samudra into repeatable, manufacturable commercial products which includes:

· Study and master the DRDO and NIIST Technology Transfer documentation

· Translate process requirements into engineering specifications

· Prepare standard configurations for different capacities

· Develop design calculations

· Develop Process Flow Diagrams

· Prepare P&IDs

· Prepare equipment specifications

· Define tank/chamber sizing

· Develop standard BOMs

· Develop SOPs for fabrication, assembly and commissioning

· Develop operation and maintenance manuals

· Establish quality control parameters

· Develop troubleshooting protocols

The candidate should independently perform or verify calculations relating to: Daily sewage generation| Peak flow| Hydraulic retention time| Organic loading| Reactor volume| Equalisation capacity| Aeration requirement| Oxygen demand| Blower sizing| Pump sizing| Media requirement| Sludge generation| Filtration loading| Disinfection dosage| Treated water storage.

**Preferred B.Tech / M.Tech in:** Environmental Engineering| Chemical Engineering| Civil Engineering with Environmental specialization| Biotechnology / Biochemical Engineering| Environmental Biotechnology.

Candidates from Mechanical Engineering may also be considered if they possess substantial hands-on wastewater-treatment experience.

**Business Description**

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra-high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

**Role Purpose**

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the **Premier Banking** team.

As a Premier Relationship Manager or Senior Premier Relationship Manager at HSBC, you will be at the forefront of our flagship "Premier Banking" offering, serving as a vital link to our high-net-worth individual (HNI) clients. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and expand HSBC Premier relationships, aligning with business targets and strategic plans. You will act as a single point of contact for Premier customers, anticipating their needs and delivering comprehensive banking and financial advisory services. Your role involves ensuring exceptional customer service in accordance with Global Premier Service Standards, identifying opportunities for wealth reviews, and providing tailored wealth solutions. Success in this role requires maintaining the highest standards of integrity, adhering to regulatory requirements, and fostering trust with both the bank and our clients.

**Principal Responsibilities**

**Business Impact:**

  

* Maximize profit and growth of Premier client portfolios by developing new and existing relationships.
* Achieve financial targets through effective client engagement and service delivery.
* Conduct regular client reviews to understand needs and recommend suitable products and services. Cross sell products.

**Client Management:**

  

* Build and maintain strong client relationships to ensure retention and satisfaction. Need based selling.
* Utilize client relationship management tools to keep client information accurate and up to date.
* Develop strategies to increase wallet share and manage a prospect pipeline effectively.

**Team Collaboration:**

  

* Work as part of an integrated branch management team to meet standards and deliver operating models.
* Collaborate with colleagues across the business to support client needs and achieve performance measures.

**Operational Excellence:**

  

* Ensure compliance with HSBC's policies, including KYC, AML, and sanctions guidelines.
* Manage operational risk and adhere to sales quality requirements.
* Attend mandatory training and report any unusual activities promptly.

**Leadership & Development:**

  

* Support team members and contribute to a positive work environment.
* Establish a network of internal relationships and gather feedback from colleagues and clients.

**Knowledge & Experience**

  

* Educational Background: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
* For GCB 6: 3 to 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager
* For GCB 5: More than 5 years of Retail/Premier Banking segment as Relationship Manager.
* Pro-tip : Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Sales Achievements: Demonstrated success & experience in Wealth products.
* Client Relationship Management: Proven experience managing relationships with high-net-worth clients.
* Wealth Management Expertise: Strong technical skills in wealth management.
* Communication & Influence: Excellent communication skills with a focus on client engagement and influence.
* Sales & Networking Skills: Strong orientation towards sales, networking, and portfolio management.
* Product Knowledge: Comprehensive understanding of financial services products, services, and client relationship management systems.
* Business Banking Insight: Familiarity with business banking client segments and related products and services.
* Regulatory Compliance: Possession of valid licenses and accreditations in wealth management as required by local regulations.
* Risk Management: Ability to collaborate effectively with Compliance, Credit & Risk, and Internal Control teams to maintain a balanced risk environment.
* Language Proficiency: Proficient in English and local languages.

**Accreditations**

  

* Professional Qualifications: Obtain necessary professional and regulatory certifications such as AMFI, IRDA, NISM XXI A (PMS Certification), and NISM XIII (SIF Certification) as per market requirements.

Additional Information

*Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.*

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result\-oriented **Purchase Manager** with relevant experience in **solar products and equipment procurement**. The candidate will be responsible for end\-to\-end purchasing, vendor management, price negotiation, purchase order management, and ensuring the timely availability of quality materials for solar projects.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage end\-to\-end procurement of **solar products, equipment, components, and project materials**.
* Identify, evaluate, and develop reliable suppliers and vendors.
* Source materials and obtain competitive quotations from multiple vendors.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other commercial terms.
* Prepare and manage purchase orders and procurement documentation.
* Ensure timely procurement and delivery of materials according to project requirements.
* Coordinate with **Project, Stores, Accounts, and Management teams** for smooth procurement operations.
* Verify product specifications, quality, quantity, pricing, and delivery terms before placing orders.
* Maintain strong relationships with existing suppliers and develop new vendor networks.
* Monitor pending purchase orders, delivery schedules, and material availability.
* Track market prices and maintain awareness of solar product availability and pricing trends.
* Resolve supplier\-related issues involving quality, delivery, pricing, and replacement of materials.
* Maintain accurate records of quotations, purchase orders, invoices, and vendor details.
* Ensure cost\-effective procurement while maintaining required quality standards.

Required Qualifications

* Degree/Diploma or relevant qualification in **Procurement, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering**, or a related field.
* Minimum **3 years of relevant experience in purchase/procurement**, preferably in the **Solar Energy or Renewable Energy industry**.
* Strong knowledge of **solar products, equipment, components, and procurement processes**.
* Excellent vendor management and negotiation skills.
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Proficiency in **MS Office, especially MS Excel**.
* Strong organizational and analytical skills.

Preferred Candidate

* Candidates with hands\-on experience in **solar product purchasing/procurement** will be preferred.
* **Immediate joiners** or candidates with a short notice period are preferred.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple procurement requirements.
* Strong focus on **cost control, timely delivery, and vendor relationship management**.

* Handle walk\-in customers, understand their requirements, and provide accurate product/service information.
* Enter walk\-in and lead details into company software and update the status daily.
* Address customer queries professionally and ensure high satisfaction levels.
* Ensure the safe movement and submission of gold and cash to Head Office/regional office or other branches as required.
* Maintain proper grooming standards, wear company uniform or formals with formal shoes.

**2\. Sales \& Lead Management**

* Identify and generate business opportunities through cold calls, follow\-ups, and marketing activities.
* Create and maintain a database of prospective customers, follow\-up until conversion, and support customers throughout the closing process.
* Execute marketing initiatives and distribute leaflets/pamphlets near by radius to increase brand visibility.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers to increase repeat business and referrals.

**3\. NBFC Coordination \& Business Development**

* Visit nearby NBFCs regularly to generate business leads.
* Build and maintain a healthy NBFC network and ensure consistent business inflow.

**4\. Sales Process Oversight \& Inventory Management**

* Oversee complete sales cycle from greeting to negotiation and final closing.
* Track daily sales performance and ensure targets are met.
* Maintain stock records, monitor stock ageing, and coordinate for replenishment.
* Ensure all operational equipment (POS, weighing machines, etc.) are functional.
* Prepare daily/weekly reports on sales, stock, and transactions.

**5\. Compliance \& SOP Adherence**

* Follow all safety, compliance, stock handling procedures and company SOPs without deviation.
* Conduct regular stock audits and ensure branch security protocols are followed.

**6\. Meetings, Reporting \& Inter\-Branch Support**

* Attend weekly, monthly, and quarterly review meetings without fail.
* Be flexible to support and work from other branches when required based on business needs.
* Ensure timely reporting, assigned tasks completion, and coordination with Regional Office /Head Office.
